table.name: TLGNC_BIZEVENT
table.description: Contains all events which had a business-relevant effect on Logon, such as modifying the status or position of trucks, orders, etc. This is NOT an audit log, and it is complete only in the sense of 'best effort'. Consistency of a chain of events is not guaranteed because of for example possible loss of PDA events. By definition, existing events are NOT updated. A new event is written instead to correct a state caused by an older event.

column.name: BIZEVENT_ID
column.description: PK. Only business relevant events are stored here, not all actions (not an audit log). The focus lies always on the newest event.

column.name: BIZEVENT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_bizevent_type_bs. The type of event, such as New, Transmitted to pool, ..., Position, Pool ack, Set Silo, ... There are different sets of events: caused by the application (user action) and such from external systems (PDA, Parallel).

column.name: DESCRIPTION
column.description: Human readable description of the event, in English. The text contained here should help interpreting a chain of events if shown in the UI, but must not be interpreted by the application.

column.name: TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. The truck related to this event. When an event is written, current PDA/Driver to Truck assignments must be checked.

column.name: TRAILER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_trailer. The trailer related to this event. When an event is written, current truck/trailer assignments must be checked.

column.name: CONTAINER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_container. The container related to this event. When an event is written, current truck/trailer/wagon/container assignments must be checked, i.e. a container can lie on a trailer, which is connected to a truck. All 3 references must be set in this case.

column.name: WAGON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_wagon. The wagon related to this event. Wagon information of a bizevent comes from the application or from the rail operator via edifact, see tlgnc_edifact_header/data.

column.name: SIMPLE_VEHICLE_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_simple_vehicle. The simple vehicle related to this event. Vehicle information of a bizevent comes from the application.

column.name: ORDER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_order. The order related to this event.

column.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_assignment. The assignment related to this event.

column.name: COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude coordinates of the object(s) at the time the event occurred. Used for 'Letzte Kennung' of truck/trailer etc.

column.name: COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute coordinates of the object(s) at the time the event occurred. Used for 'Letzte Kennung' of truck/trailer etc.

column.name: RAILWAY_STATION_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_railway_station. Railway station of the object(s) at the time the event occurred.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. Reference is set if a shippingpoint is related to the event.

column.name: SHIPTO_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shipto. Reference is set if a shipto is related to the event.

column.name: COORD_TRUCK_HOMEBASE_FLAG
column.description: Set to true(1), if the received coordinates match the homebase coordinats of the truck (if truck_id set). 0, if truck involved, but not its homebase. Null, if there is no truck involved.

column.name: EVENT_TS
column.description: Creation timestamp (date and time) of the event (a) in the original system/PDA (if available/sent) or b) set to 'now' by Logon when receiving/storing the event. This is the main time information about when the event actually occurred. Depending on the use case, events are either displayed sorted by when it happened (event_ts) or when we received (and processed) them, i.e. ctl_cre_ts, creation date in the logon system/DB.

column.name: ORIGINAL_MOPEVENT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_mopevent_header_id. The MOP event which caused this business event. Note, that one MOP event can potentially cause several Bizevents, depending on the necessary actions which are needed. This reference is for informal purposes mainly.
